modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On July 12, 1963: Pauline Reade, 16, disappears in Gorton, England, the first victim in the Moors murders.
On July 12, 1971: The Australian Aboriginal flag is flown for the first time.
July 12 is observed as The Twelfth, also known as Orangemen's Day (Northern Ireland, Scotland, Newfoundland and Labrador).
July 12 is observed as The second day of Naadam (Mongolia).
On July 12, 2001: Space Shuttle program: Space Shuttle Atlantis is launched on mission STS-104, carrying the Quest Joint Airlock to the International Space Station.
